lessons.title: The Wasila and the Pool of Intercession

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضًا وَلَهُ جَزَاءً وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ قَوْمِهِ وَرَسُولًا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, a blessing that is pleasing to You, a reward for him, and a fulfillment of his due, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the Praised Station which You promised him, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his people or any messenger on behalf of his nation, and send blessings upon all his brethren among the prophets and the righteous, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan takunu laka ridhan wa lahu jaza'an wa li-haqqihi ada'an, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wal-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, wajzihi 'anna afdhala ma jazayta nabiyyan 'an qawmihi wa rasulan 'an ummatihi, wa salli 'ala jami'i ikhwanihi minan-nabiyyina was-salihina, ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فَضَائِلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَشَرَائِفَ زَكَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَعَوَاطِفَ رَأْفَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَتَحِيَّتِكَ وَفَضَائِلَ آلَائِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، قَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ وَفَاتِحِ الْبِرِّ وَنَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ وَسَيِّدِ الْأُمَّةِ.
items.en: O Allah, place the excellences of Your blessings, the noblest of Your graces, the increase of Your benedictions, the tenderness of Your compassion and mercy and greeting, and the excellences of Your favors upon our master Muhammad, the master of the messengers and the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, the leader of goodness, the opener of piety, the Prophet of Mercy, and the master of the nation.
items.translit: Allahummaj'al fadha'ila salawatika wa shara'ifa zakawatika wa nawamiya barakatika wa 'awatifa ra'fatika wa rahmatika wa tahiyyatika wa fadha'ila ala'ika 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin sayyidil-mursalina wa rasuli Rabbil-'alamina, qa'idil-khayri wa fatihil-birri wa nabiyyir-rahmati wa sayyidil-ummah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا تُزْلِفُ بِهِ قُرْبَهُ وَتُقِرُّ بِهِ عَيْنَهُ، يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ.
items.en: O Allah, raise him to a Praised Station by which You draw him near and by which You delight his eye, one which the first and the last shall envy him for.
items.translit: Allahummab-'ath-hu maqaman mahmudan tuzlifu bihi qurbahu wa tuqirru bihi 'aynahu, yaghbituhu bihil-awwaluna wal-akhirun.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِهِ الْفَضْلَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالْوَسِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَالْمَنْزِلَةَ الشَّامِخَةَ.
items.en: O Allah, grant him grace and excellence, honor and the wasila, the elevated rank and the lofty station.
items.translit: Allahumma atihil-fadhla wal-fadhilata wash-sharafa wal-wasilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata wal-manzilatash-shamikhah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ أَوَّلَ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلَ مُشَفَّعٍ.
items.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, bring him to what he hopes for, and make him the first to intercede and the first whose intercession is accepted.
items.translit: Allahumma ati Sayyidana Muhammadanil-wasilata wa balligh-hu ma'mulahu waj'alhu awwala shafi'in wa awwala mushaffa'.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَارْفَعْ فِي أَهْلِ عِلِّيِّينَ دَرَجَتَهُ، وَفِي عَالَمِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مَنْزِلَتَهُ.
items.en: O Allah, magnify his proof, weigh down his scale, make manifest his argument, and raise his rank among the people of 'Illiyyin, and his station among the world of those brought near.
items.translit: Allahumma 'azzim burhanahu wa thaqqil mizanahu wa ablij hujjatahu warfa' fi ahli 'illiyyina darajatahu, wa fi 'alamil-muqarrabina manzilatah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ شَفَاعَتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ كَأْسِهِ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلَا نَادِمِينَ وَلَا شَاكِّينَ وَلَا مُبَدِّلِينَ وَلَا مُغَيِّرِينَ وَلَا فَاتِنِينَ وَلَا مَفْتُونِينَ، آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, let us live upon his way and let us die upon his religion, and make us among the people of his intercession, and gather us in his company, and bring us to his Pool, and give us to drink from his cup, not disgraced, nor regretful, nor doubting, nor changing, nor altering, nor tempting, nor tempted. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Allahumma ahyina 'ala sunnatihi wa tawaffana 'ala millatihi, waj'alna min ahli shafa'atihi, wahshurna fi zumratihi, wa awridna hawdahu, wasqina min ka'sihi ghayra khazaya wa la nadimina wa la shakkina wa la mubaddilina wa la mughayyirina wa la fatinina wa la maftunin, amin ya Rabbal-'alamin.

lessons.title: Blessings on the Prophets and a Prayer of Forgiveness

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ مَعَ إِخْوَانِهِ النَّبِيِّينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him, together with his brethren the prophets.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata, wab'ath-hul-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu ma'a ikhwanihin-nabiyyin.

items.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ رَحْمَةً وَسَيِّدِ الْأُمَّةِ، وَعَلَى أَبِينَا سَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَأُمِّنَا سَيِّدَتِنَا حَوَّاءَ وَمَنْ وَلَدَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِينَ، وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy and master of the nation, and upon our father, our master Adam, and our mother, our lady Hawwa, and whoever they bore among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and send blessings upon all Your angels among the people of the heavens and the earths, and upon us together with them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Sallallahu 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyi rahmatan wa sayyidil-ummah, wa 'ala abina Sayyidina Adama wa ummina Sayyidatina Hawwa'a wa man waladaa minan-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihina, wa salli 'ala mala'ikatika ajma'ina min ahlis-samawati wal-ardhina, wa 'alayna ma'ahum ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَأَلِّفْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive me my sins, and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small, and forgive all believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and join us together with them in good things. My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li dhunubi wa li-walidayya warhamhuma kama rabbayani saghiran, wa li-jami'il-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat, wa allif baynana wa baynahum bil-khayrat, Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim.

lessons.title: Light of Lights, Secret of Secrets

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ وَسِرِّ الْأَسْرَارِ وَسَيِّدِ الْأَبْرَارِ وَزَيْنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، عَدَدَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنْ قَطْرِ الْأَمْطَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا نَبَتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنَ النَّبَاتِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Light of Lights, the Secret of Secrets, the master of the righteous, the ornament of the excellent messengers, and the most noble of those over whom night has darkened and day has shone, as many as have fallen from the beginning of the world to its end of raindrops, and as many as have grown from the beginning of the world to its end of plants and trees, an enduring blessing lasting as long as the dominion of Allah, the One, the All-Subduing.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin nuril-anwari wa sirril-asrari wa sayyidil-abrari wa zaynil-mursalinal-akhyari, wa akrami man azlama 'alayhil-laylu wa ashraqa 'alayhin-nahar, 'adada ma nazala min awwalid-dunya ila akhiriha min qatril-amtar, wa 'adada ma nabata min awwalid-dunya ila akhiriha minan-nabati wal-ashjar, salatan da'imatan bidawami mulkillahil-wahidil-qahhar.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُكْرِمُ بِهَا مَثْوَاهُ وَتُشَرِّفُ بِهَا عُقْبَاهُ وَتُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُنَاهُ وَرِضَاهُ. هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةُ تَعْظِيمًا لِحَقِّكَ يَا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدُ. (ثَلَاثًا)
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You honor his abode, ennoble his afterlife, and by which You bring him on the Day of Resurrection to his wish and his contentment. This blessing is in reverence for your right, O our master Muhammad. (recited three times)
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan tukrimu biha mathwahu wa tusharrifu biha 'uqbahu wa tuballighuhu biha yawmal-qiyamati munahu wa ridhah. Hadhihis-salatu ta'ziman li-haqqika ya Sayyidina Muhammad. (thalathan)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَاءِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمِيمِ الْمُلْكِ وَدَالِ الدَّوَامِ، السَّيِّدِ الْكَامِلِ الْفَاتِحِ الْخَاتِمِ، عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِكَ كَائِنٌ أَوْ قَدْ كَانَ، كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ وَذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ وَكُلَّمَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ بَاقِيَةً بِبَقَائِكَ لَا مُنْتَهَى لَهَا دُونَ عِلْمِكَ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. (ثَلَاثًا)
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Ha of Mercy, the Mim of Sovereignty, the Dal of Endurance, the complete master, the opener, the seal, as many as exists or has existed in Your knowledge, every time the rememberers remember him, and every time the heedless are heedless of remembering You and him — an enduring blessing lasting as You endure, remaining as You remain, with no end to it short of Your knowledge, for indeed You have power over all things. (recited three times)
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin ha'ir-rahmati wa mimil-mulki wa dalid-dawam, as-sayyidil-kamilil-fatihil-khatim, 'adada ma fi 'ilmika ka'inun aw qad kana, kullama dhakarahu wa dhakarahudh-dhakiruna wa kullama ghafala 'an dhikrika wa dhikrihil-ghafilun, salatan da'imatan bidawamika baqiyatan bibaqa'ika la muntaha laha duna 'ilmika, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (thalathan)

lessons.title: More Radiant than the Full Moon

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ أَبْهَى شُمُوسِ الْهُدَى نُورًا وَأَبْهَرُهَا، وَأَشْهَرُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ فَخْرًا وَأَشْهَرُهَا، وَنُورُهُ أَظْهَرُ أَنْوَارِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَأَطْهَرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا خَلْقًا وَأَعْدَلُهَا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, who is the most radiant and dazzling of the suns of guidance, the most renowned of the prophets in glory, and whose light is the most manifest and purest of the lights of character, and the most noble and most just in creation.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi huwa abhaa shumusil-hudaa nuran wa abharuha, wa ashharul-anbiya'i fakhran wa ashharuha, wa nuruhu azharu anwaril-akhlaqi wa atharuha wa akramuha khalqan wa 'adaluha.

items.ar: سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ أَبْهَى مِنَ الْقَمَرِ التَّامِّ، وَأَكْرَمُ مِنَ السَّحَابِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ وَالْبَحْرِ الْخِضَمِّ.
items.en: our master Muhammad, who is more radiant than the full moon, and more generous than the sent-forth clouds and the abundant sea.
items.translit: Sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi huwa abhaa minal-qamarit-tammi, wa akramu minas-sahabil-mursalati wal-bahril-khidamm.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي قُرِنَتِ الْبَرَكَةُ بِذَاتِهِ وَمُحَيَّاهُ، وَتَعَطَّرَتِ الْعَوَالِمُ بِطِيبِ ذِكْرِهِ وَرَيَّاهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, whose very being and countenance was joined with blessing, and by whose good remembrance and fragrance the worlds were perfumed.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadinil-ladhi qurinatil-barakatu bi-dhatihi wa muhayyahu, wa ta'attaratil-'awalimu bi-tibi dhikrihi wa rayyah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, and grant peace.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sallim.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad, just as You blessed and blessed and had mercy upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin warham Sayyidana Muhammadan kama sallayta wa barakta wa tarahhamta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid.

lessons.title: Filling This World and the Next

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa nabiyyika wa rasulikan-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ، وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ، وَاجْزِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ، وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ الدُّنْيَا وَمِلْءَ الْآخِرَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and reward our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and grant peace upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'ad-dunya wa mil'al-akhirah, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'ad-dunya wa mil'al-akhirah, warham Sayyidana Muhammadan wa ala Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'ad-dunya wa mil'al-akhirah, wajzi Sayyidana Muhammadan wa ala Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'ad-dunya wa mil'al-akhirah, wa sallim 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin mil'ad-dunya wa mil'al-akhirah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You commanded us to send blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as it is fitting that blessings be sent upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama amartana an nusalliya 'alayh, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama yambaghi an yusalla 'alayh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ الْمُصْطَفَى وَرَسُولِكَ الْمُرْتَضَى وَوَلِيِّكَ الْمُجْتَبَى وَأَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِ السَّمَاءِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Your chosen prophet, Your well-pleasing messenger, Your selected friend, and Your trustee over the revelation of heaven.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala nabiyyikal-mustafa wa rasulikal-murtadha wa waliyyikal-mujtaba wa aminika 'ala wahyis-sama.

lessons.title: The Quranic Command and a Closing Salawat

items.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ. يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا.
items.en: Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
items.translit: Innallaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'alan-nabi. Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu sallu 'alayhi wa sallimu tasliman.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ.
items.en: O Allah, forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any rancor toward those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind, Merciful.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat, waghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-imani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lil-ladhina amanu Rabbana innaka Ra'ufur-Rahim.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon the Hashimite prophet, our master Muhammad, and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant peace.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'alan-nabiyyil-hashimiyyi Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim tasliman.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the best of creation, a blessing that pleases You and pleases him and through which You are pleased with us, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin khayril-bariyyati salatan turdhika wa turdhihi wa tardha biha 'anna, ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، جَزِيلًا جَمِيلًا دَائِمًا بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant, good, blessed peace, plentiful, beautiful, enduring as long as the dominion of Allah endures.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallim tasliman kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi, jazilan jamilan da'iman bidawami mulkillah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مِلْءَ الْفَضَاءِ وَعَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، صَلَاةً تُوَازِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, filling space and as many as the stars in the sky, a blessing that balances the heavens and the earth, and as many as You have created and will create until the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi mil'al-fadha'i wa 'adadan-nujumi fis-sama'i, salatan tuwazinus-samawati wal-ardha, wa 'adada ma khalaqta wa ma anta khaliquhu ila yawmil-qiyamah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima fil-'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَقِّ نُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِحَقِّ عَرْشِكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَجَمَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ الْمَخْزُونَةِ الْمَكْنُونَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your Great right, and by the right of the light of Your noble Face, and by the right of Your Great Throne, and by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your beauty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden Names which none of Your creation has been shown.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-haqqikal-'azimi wa bi-haqqi nuri wajhikal-karimi wa bi-haqqi 'arshikal-'azimi wa bima hamala kursiyyuka min 'azamatika wa jalalika wa jamalika wa baha'ika wa qudratika wa sultanika, wa bi-haqqi asma'ikal-makhzunatil-maknunatil-lati lam yattali' 'alayha ahadun min khalqik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ، وَعَلَى الْبِحَارِ وَالْأَوْدِيَةِ فَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You by the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted, and upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the mountains and they became anchored, and upon the seas and the valleys and they flowed, and upon the springs and they gushed forth, and upon the clouds and they rained.
items.translit: Allahumma as'aluka bil-ismil-ladhi wadha'tahu 'alal-layli fa-azlam, wa 'alan-nahari fastanar, wa 'alas-samawati fastaqallat, wa 'alal-ardhi fastaqarrat, wa 'alal-jibali fa-arsat, wa 'alal-bihari wal-awdiyati fa-jarat, wa 'alal-'uyuni fa-naba'at, wa 'alas-sahabi fa-amtarat.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَعَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ.
items.en: And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and upon the angels brought near.
items.translit: Wa as'alukallahumma bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Israfila 'alayhis-salamu, wa bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Jibrila 'alayhis-salamu wa 'alal-mala'ikatil-muqarrabin.

items.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالِاسْمِ الْمَكْتُوبِ عَلَى وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ.
items.en: And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written around the Throne, and by the names written around the Chair, and I ask You, O Allah, by the Name written upon the olive leaf.
items.translit: Wa as'alukallahumma bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-'arshi wa bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-kursiyyi, wa as'alukallahumma bil-ismil-maktubi 'ala waraqiz-zaytun.
